Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR adds only a test case validating etcd recovery behavior, not deployment manifests, operator code, or controllers that would introduce scheduling constraints. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | PR adds new Ginkgo It() test case; stdout writes in test blocks are intercepted by framework and do not violate OTE Binary Stdout Contract. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The new test contains no hardcoded IPv4 literals or CIDRs, no string-based IPv4 parsing, and dynamically selects iptables versus ip6tables based on the node IP. Therefore, it will run correctly in IPv6-only, disconnected CI environments. |
